blocks.text: Jacobsen — West Coast Contemporary Townhomes near Morgan Crossing

parts.t: Jacobsen

is a community of 65 West Coast contemporary townhomes by Ikonik Homes at 2687 158 Street in Grandview Surrey, about 0.4 km from The Shops at Morgan Crossing. Homes have 10-foot ceilings on the main floor, side-by-side double garages and private yards with gas BBQ hookups.
Homes range from 1,738 to 2,220 square feet across three levels, with three bedrooms and a finished lower-level flex room in every home that can work as a fourth bedroom, home office or gym.
The 2,400 sq ft clubhouse has an exercise studio, a theatre room, a lounge, a fire pit and a children's play area.

Jacobsen was conceived to bridge the gap between townhome and detached living. The 10-foot main floor ceilings immediately set the tone — light floods in through oversized windows and the open-concept layouts amplify every square foot. Kitchens feature quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and gas stoves with BBQ hookups extending the cooking experience outdoors.

Upper levels hold the primary bedroom and two more bedrooms. The finished lower-level room works as a fourth bedroom, home gym or guest room. Finishes vary by unit, so check the listing details for the home you're considering.
Amenities & Outdoor Living
Outdoor living is a genuine feature at Jacobsen. Homes have private yards and patios with gas BBQ hookups, and a walking trail connects the complex to Morgan Heights Linear Park.
The clubhouse includes an exercise studio, a theatre room and a lounge, with an outdoor fire pit and a children's play area.

Buyer FAQs
What is the price range for Jacobsen townhomes in South Surrey?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Jacobsen sales and current listings.
How large are the homes at Jacobsen?

Jacobsen townhomes range from 1,738 to 2,220 square feet across three levels. All homes have three bedrooms, a finished lower-level flex room that can serve as a fourth bedroom, and a side-by-side double garage.
How far is Jacobsen from Morgan Crossing?
Jacobsen is about 0.4 km from The Shops at Morgan Crossing.
Does Jacobsen allow pets?

Pet policies at Jacobsen are governed by the strata corporation and typically permit pets with reasonable restrictions. Always confirm current pet bylaws with strata management before purchasing, particularly if you have larger dogs or multiple animals.
Does Jacobsen allow rentals?

Under BC's Strata Property Act amendments effective November 24, 2022, residential strata corporations cannot restrict long-term rentals, so Jacobsen townhomes can be rented long term. Short-term rentals (such as Airbnb or VRBO) remain subject to strata bylaws and municipal licensing. Buyers should review the current strata bylaws, Form B, and recent strata minutes before purchasing.
What schools are near Jacobsen at Morgan Crossing?

Jacobsen is in the Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Southridge School, an independent K-12 school at 2656 160 Street, is about 0.6 km away.
What amenities does Jacobsen offer?

Jacobsen has a clubhouse with an exercise studio, a theatre room, a lounge, a fire pit and a children's play area. Homes have private yards and patios with gas BBQ hookups, and a walking trail connects the complex to Morgan Heights Linear Park.
